title: "Yeouido transit SCM — fit on the full pre-period (original ADH 2003/2010 approach)"
output: html_document

<!--
Main table: V and W chosen jointly, without a split, by minimising the prediction error over all 49 pre-treatment weeks (Synth).
  Recorded values to reproduce: ATT +4.763% · pre RMSPE 389.2 · ratio 3.178 · p_ratio(τ5) 0.0263
Plots: the original plot helpers (plot_synth_custom / plot_mspe_ratio_ranked /
  plot_placebo_gaps_limit / plot_placebo_ratio_hist) are used unchanged.
Output: OUT_DIR (default output/04_yeouido_transit_scm/SCM_yeouido_nested/, +plots/)
Paths: REPO_ROOT, RAW_DIR and OUT_DIR in the setup chunk. Each is taken from an already-defined R object, then an environment variable, then a default.
  - When this Rmd is knitted directly the working directory is code/04_yeouido_transit_scm/, so REPO_ROOT defaults to "../.."
  - The R scripts in this folder (run from the repository root) define REPO_ROOT, RAW_DIR and OUT_DIR before eval-ing the chunks, so their values are used.
RESTRICTED DATA REQUIRED (restricted data required): smart-card OD data (Data Safety Center, export-restricted) are not in this repository.
Required input files (place under RAW_DIR):
  - od_with_pop_sum_without_holiday.csv   (flow, week, 이용자수_주총합 = weekly total users)
  - df_scm_g.csv                          (unit_id, unit_name, week, is_treat, tranfer, pop_dong, ...)
Runtime: main fit a few minutes + 81 placebos about 20-40 minutes + LOO and in-time a few minutes.
-->
#1. set up
```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
suppressMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(readr); library(purrr)
  library(tibble); library(ggplot2); library(lubridate); library(Synth)
})
options(scipen = 999)

## ---- Paths (edit here or set env vars) -------------------------------
## Already-defined object (set by the R scripts before eval) > environment variable > default.
## Knitting directly: working dir = this Rmd's folder -> REPO_ROOT default "../.."; eval from the repo root: "."
if (!exists("REPO_ROOT")) REPO_ROOT <- Sys.getenv("REPO_ROOT",
  if (dir.exists(file.path("code", "04_yeouido_transit_scm"))) "." else file.path("..", ".."))
if (!exists("RAW_DIR")) RAW_DIR <- Sys.getenv("RAW_DIR", file.path(REPO_ROOT, "data/restricted"))   # restricted data required
if (!exists("OUT_DIR")) OUT_DIR <- Sys.getenv("OUT_DIR", file.path(REPO_ROOT, "output", "04_yeouido_transit_scm", "SCM_yeouido_nested"))
HERE <- OUT_DIR
PLOT <- file.path(HERE, "plots")
dir.create(PLOT, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

PREDS       <- c("tranfer", "pop_dong")
```

#2. data
```{r data}
## ── Panel construction (same as the canonical script) ─────────────────
nh <- read_csv(file.path(RAW_DIR, "od_with_pop_sum_without_holiday.csv"),
               show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(unit_name = flow, week = as.Date(week), users_nh = 이용자수_주총합)   # 이용자수_주총합 = weekly total users (input column name)

df_scm <- read.csv(file.path(RAW_DIR, "df_scm_g.csv"), fileEncoding = "UTF-8") %>%
  mutate(week = as.Date(week), unit_id_num = as.integer(unit_id),
         unit_name_en = unit_name) %>%
  filter(week >= WIN_START, week <= WIN_END) %>%
  inner_join(nh, by = c("unit_name", "week")) %>%
  mutate(users = users_nh) %>% select(-users_nh)

nu <- n_distinct(df_scm$unit_id_num)
ok_wk <- df_scm %>% count(week) %>% filter(n == nu) %>% pull(week)
df_scm <- df_scm %>% filter(week %in% ok_wk) %>%
  mutate(week_index = dense_rank(week)) %>%
  arrange(unit_id_num, week_index) %>% as.data.frame()

idx_tbl <- df_scm %>% distinct(week_index, week) %>% arrange(week_index)
final_pre_idx <- idx_tbl$week_index[idx_tbl$week <  POLICY_DATE]
post_idx      <- idx_tbl$week_index[idx_tbl$week >= POLICY_DATE]
all_idx       <- idx_tbl$week_index
n_pre <- length(final_pre_idx); n_post <- length(post_idx)

treat_id <- df_scm %>% filter(is_treat %in% c(TRUE, "True")) %>%
  distinct(unit_id_num) %>% pull() %>% as.integer()
donor_ids <- sort(intersect(DONORS_185939, unique(df_scm$unit_id_num)))

cat(sprintf("treated %d | donors %d | pre %d weeks | post %d weeks\n",
            treat_id, length(donor_ids), n_pre, n_post))
```

3. fit-fn
```{r fit-fn}
## ── special predictors: block means over the given window split into 5 ──
sp_make <- function(idx, n_blocks = N_SP_BLOCK, dep = "users") {
  ed <- round(seq(0, length(idx), length.out = n_blocks + 1))
  lapply(seq_len(n_blocks), function(b)
    list(dep, as.integer(idx[(ed[b] + 1):ed[b + 1]]), "mean"))
}

## ── nested fit: no split — V and W optimised jointly over the full pre-period ──
## If custom_v is given, V is fixed and only W is fitted (used for LOO vfix)
fit_nested <- function(tid, ctrl, pre_idx = final_pre_idx,
                       eval_post_idx = post_idx, df = df_scm, preds = PREDS,
                       custom_v = NULL) {
  tplot <- c(pre_idx, eval_post_idx)
  dp <- Synth::dataprep(
    foo = df, predictors = preds, predictors.op = "mean",
    special.predictors = sp_make(pre_idx), dependent = "users",
    unit.variable = "unit_id_num", unit.names.variable = "unit_name_en",
    time.variable = "week_index",
    treatment.identifier = as.integer(tid),
    controls.identifier  = sort(as.integer(ctrl)),
    time.predictors.prior = pre_idx, time.optimize.ssr = pre_idx,
    time.plot = tplot)
  invisible(utils::capture.output(
    so <- if (is.null(custom_v)) Synth::synth(data.prep.obj = dp, verbose = FALSE)
          else Synth::synth(data.prep.obj = dp, custom.v = custom_v, verbose = FALSE)))

  Y1 <- as.numeric(dp$Y1plot)
  Y0 <- as.numeric(dp$Y0plot %*% so$solution.w)
  g  <- Y1 - Y0; tt <- dp$tag$time.plot
  pm <- tt %in% pre_idx; qm <- tt %in% eval_post_idx
  list(dp = dp, so = so, v = as.numeric(so$solution.v),
       Y1 = Y1, Y0 = Y0, gap = g, t = tt,
       pre  = sqrt(mean(g[pm]^2)), post = sqrt(mean(g[qm]^2)),
       ratio = sqrt(mean(g[qm]^2)) / sqrt(mean(g[pm]^2)),
       att = mean(g[qm]), base = mean(Y1[pm]),
       att_pct = mean(g[qm]) / mean(Y1[pm]) * 100)
}
```

```{r main-fit}
M <- fit_nested(treat_id, donor_ids)

cat(sprintf("nested: ATT %.1f (%+.2f%%) | pre RMSPE %.1f | ratio %.3f\n",
            M$att, M$att_pct, M$pre, M$ratio))

cmp <- tribble(
  ~spec,                                     ~ATT_pct, ~pre_RMSPE, ~ratio,
  "nested recorded value (replication target)", 4.763,    389.2,     3.178,
  "nested (this run)",          round(M$att_pct,3), round(M$pre,1), round(M$ratio,3),
  "adhcv former canonical (reference)",         5.091,    472.6,     2.750,
  "ADH2015 original (reference)",               5.811,    660.0,     2.283)
print(as.data.frame(cmp))
write_excel_csv(cmp, file.path(HERE, "spec_comparison_nested.csv"))

v_tbl <- tibble(predictor = c(PREDS, paste0("sp_block", 1:N_SP_BLOCK)), V = M$v)
print(as.data.frame(v_tbl), digits = 4)
write_excel_csv(v_tbl, file.path(HERE, "vweights_D81_nested.csv"))

w_tbl <- tibble(unit_id_num = as.integer(M$dp$tag$controls.identifier),
                weight = as.numeric(M$so$solution.w)) %>%
  left_join(df_scm %>% distinct(unit_id_num, unit_name), by = "unit_id_num") %>%
  arrange(desc(weight))
print(head(w_tbl, 8))
write_excel_csv(w_tbl, file.path(HERE, "weights_D81_nested.csv"))

path_tbl <- tibble(
  week_index = M$t,
  week = idx_tbl$week[match(M$t, idx_tbl$week_index)],
  period = ifelse(M$t %in% final_pre_idx, "pre", "post"),
  actual = M$Y1, synthetic = M$Y0, gap = M$gap)
write_excel_csv(path_tbl, file.path(HERE, "path_D81_nested.csv"))

vline_idx <- min(post_idx)
saveRDS(M, file.path(HERE, "M_nested.rds"))   # reused to redraw plots without re-running
```

# 5. Plot helpers

```{r plot-helpers}
# ============================================================================
# [Renderer correction 2026-09-09] The "size numbers" in the helpers below were
# tuned for the August renderer (old cairo, which drew text at 1/4 size). Current
# renderers (ragg/quartz/new cairo) draw text at normal size, so text-related
# values must be multiplied by 0.24 to reproduce the old figures (reinstalling
# XQuartz does not restore the old rendering — verified).
# Correction: callers pass scale_factor/base_size arguments, and only the fixed
# offsets inside the helpers (+10/+15/+18/+5/+8/+20/+4) are scaled by 0.24
# (original values kept in the comment on each line).
# ============================================================================
# ============================================================================
# Placebo plot helpers (ggplot-based)
# Expected columns: res_pl has (treated, pre, ratio), paths_pl has (treated, t, gap)
# ============================================================================
plot_synth_custom <- function(
  type = c("path", "gap"),
  synth_res, dataprep_res,
  title_main = "", title_y = "", title_x = "Week",
  legend_pos = "bottomleft", treat_time,
  filename = NULL,
  scale_factor = 3, cex_axis = 0.9, cex_lab = 1, cex_main = 1,
  mgp_title = 1.5, mgp_ticks = 0.5, main_line = 1.0,
  family = NULL,
  legend_redraw = FALSE, legend_cex = 1.1, legend_seglen = 5,
  legend_yint = 2.4, legend_xint = 1.5   # [correction] reproduces the original legend proportions
) {
  type <- match.arg(type)

  if (!is.null(filename)) {
    dir.create(dirname(filename), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    has_ragg <- requireNamespace("ragg", quietly = TRUE)
    ext <- tolower(sub(".*\\.", "", filename))
    if (has_ragg) {
      if (ext %in% c("jpg", "jpeg")) {
        ragg::agg_jpeg(filename, width = 10, height = 10, units = "in", res = 300)
      } else {
        ragg::agg_png(filename, width = 10, height = 10, units = "in", res = 300)
      }
    } else {
      if (ext %in% c("jpg", "jpeg")) {
        jpeg(filename, width = 10, height = 10, units = "in", res = 300)
      } else {
        png(filename, width = 10, height = 10, units = "in", res = 300)
      }
    }
    on.exit(grDevices::dev.off(), add = TRUE)
  }

  if (is.null(family)) {
    family <- if (grepl("darwin", R.version$os)) "AppleGothic"
              else if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") "Malgun Gothic"
              else "NanumGothic"
  }

  op <- par(no.readonly = TRUE); on.exit(par(op), add = TRUE)
  par(family = family,
      mai = c(1.8, 2.0, 1.2, 0.8),
      cex = scale_factor, cex.axis = cex_axis,
      cex.lab = cex_lab, mgp = c(mgp_title, mgp_ticks, 0))

  if (type == "path") {
    Synth::path.plot(synth.res = synth_res, dataprep.res = dataprep_res,
                     Main = "", Ylab = title_y, Xlab = title_x,
                     Legend.position = legend_pos, tr.intake = treat_time)
    if (isTRUE(legend_redraw))   # [correction] redraws the default legend at the original proportions (large box)
      legend(legend_pos, legend = c("Treated", "Synthetic"),
             lty = c("solid", "dashed"), col = "black", lwd = 2,
             cex = legend_cex, seg.len = legend_seglen,
             y.intersp = legend_yint, x.intersp = legend_xint, bg = "white")
  } else {
    Synth::gaps.plot(synth.res = synth_res, dataprep.res = dataprep_res,
                     Main = "", Ylab = title_y, Xlab = title_x,
                     tr.intake = treat_time)
    abline(h = 0, lty = 2, col = "grey40")
  }
  mtext(title_main, side = 3, line = main_line,
        cex = cex_main * scale_factor, font = 2)
}

plot_mspe_ratio_ranked <- function(
  res_pl, pre_rmspe, ratio_main, lookup_tbl, treat_id,
  tau = 5,
  filename = NULL, width = 10, height = 9, dpi = 300,
  base_size = 10,
  legend_lbl2 = ""
) {
  stopifnot(all(c("treated", "pre", "ratio") %in% names(res_pl)))

  pl <- res_pl %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(pre), is.finite(ratio),
                  pre <= pre_rmspe * tau,
                  treated != treat_id) %>%
    dplyr::select(treated, ratio) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(kind = "Placebo")

  treated_row <- tibble::tibble(
    treated = treat_id,
    ratio   = as.numeric(ratio_main),
    kind    = "Treated"
  )

  df_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(pl, treated_row) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(ratio) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(y_idx = dplyr::row_number())

  lab_tbl <- lookup_tbl %>%
    dplyr::select(unit_id_num, unit_name_en) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(unit_id_num = as.character(unit_id_num)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()

  get_lab <- function(id) {
    nm <- lab_tbl$unit_name_en[match(as.character(id), lab_tbl$unit_id_num)]
    nm <- ifelse(is.na(nm) | is.null(nm), "", nm)
    lab <- if (nzchar(nm)) nm else as.character(id)
    if (nchar(lab) > 60) paste0(substr(lab, 1, 60), "...") else lab
  }

  df_all$label <- vapply(df_all$treated, get_lab, character(1))

  g <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_all, ggplot2::aes(x = ratio, y = y_idx)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      data  = subset(df_all, kind == "Placebo"),
      shape = 15, size = 2.8, color = "black"
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      data  = subset(df_all, kind == "Treated"),
      shape = 17, size = 5.0, color = "red"
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = df_all$y_idx,
      labels = df_all$label,
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = paste0("Post/Pre MSPE ratio - ", legend_lbl2),
      y = NULL,
      title = sprintf("Post/Pre MSPE Ratio Ranking (tau = %d)", tau)
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = base_size) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.grid.minor   = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.2, colour = "grey85"),
      panel.grid.minor.y = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.15, colour = "grey92"),
      axis.text.y        = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size),
      axis.text.x        = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size + 1.2),   # original +5
      plot.subtitle      = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size + 4.8, face = "bold"),   # original +20
      plot.title         = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size + 2.4, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)   # original +10
    )

  print(g)
  if (!is.null(filename)) {
    dir.create(dirname(filename), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    ggplot2::ggsave(filename, g, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi,
                    limitsize = FALSE)
  }
  invisible(g)
}


plot_placebo_gaps_limit <- function(
  paths_pl, res_pl, gaps_main, pre_rmspe, n_pre,
  tau = 5,
  filename = NULL, width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300,
  base_size =10,
  show_avg_placebo = FALSE,
  legend_lbl2 = ""
) {
  stopifnot(is.numeric(gaps_main), length(gaps_main) > 0)
  stopifnot(all(c("treated", "pre") %in% names(res_pl)))
  if (is.null(paths_pl) || !all(c("treated", "t", "gap") %in% names(paths_pl))) {
    stop("paths_pl must have columns: treated, t, gap")
  }

  ids_ok <- res_pl %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(pre), pre <= pre_rmspe * tau) %>%
    dplyr::pull(treated) %>% unique()

  Tlen   <- length(gaps_main)
  df_pl  <- paths_pl %>%
    dplyr::filter(treated %in% ids_ok, t >= 1, t <= Tlen)

  df_main <- tibble::tibble(
    t   = seq_len(Tlen),
    gap = as.numeric(gaps_main)
  )

  if (nrow(df_pl) == 0L) {
    warning("No placebo paths after tau filter.")
  }

  df_avg <- NULL
  if (isTRUE(show_avg_placebo) && nrow(df_pl) > 0L) {
    df_avg <- df_pl %>%
      dplyr::group_by(t) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(mean_gap = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  }

  g <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.4) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = n_pre + 1, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(data = df_pl, ggplot2::aes(t, gap, group = treated),
                       linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.2) +
    { if (!is.null(df_avg)) ggplot2::geom_line(data = df_avg,
                                               ggplot2::aes(t, mean_gap),
                                               linewidth = 0.5,
                                               linetype = "dotdash") else NULL } +
    ggplot2::geom_line(data = df_main, ggplot2::aes(t, gap), linewidth = 0.6) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = "Week", y = "Gap (Treated - Synthetic)",
      title = sprintf("Placebos Plot - %s (tau = %d)", legend_lbl2, tau)
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = base_size) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.grid         = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor   = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.text.x  = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size + 2.4),   # original +10
      axis.text.y  = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size + 2.4),   # original +10
      axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size + 3.6),   # original +15
      axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size + 3.6),   # original +15
      plot.title   = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size + 4.3, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)   # original +18
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1, Tlen),
                                expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = 0)) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = 0))

  print(g)
  if (!is.null(filename)) {
    dir.create(dirname(filename), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    ggplot2::ggsave(filename, g, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi)
  }
  invisible(g)
}


plot_placebo_ratio_hist <- function(
  res_pl, pre_rmspe, ratio_main,
  tau = 5, bins = 30,
  filename = NULL, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, base_size = 10,
  logx = FALSE
) {
  stopifnot(all(c("pre", "ratio") %in% names(res_pl)))

  df <- res_pl %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(pre), pre > 0, pre <= pre_rmspe * tau,
                  is.finite(ratio), ratio > 0)

  g <- ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes(x = ratio)) +
    ggplot2::geom_histogram(bins = bins, alpha = 0.9,
                            fill = "grey80", color = "black") +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.8) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = ratio_main, linetype = "dashed",
                        linewidth = 1.2, color = "red") +
    { if (logx) ggplot2::scale_x_log10() else NULL } +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = "MSPE ratio (Post / Pre)",
      y = "Count",
      title = sprintf("Placebo MSPE Ratio Histogram (tau = %d)", tau),
      subtitle = sprintf("Main treated ratio = %.3f", ratio_main)
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.grid    = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.text.x   = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size + 1.2),   # original +5
      axis.text.y   = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size + 1.2),   # original +5
      axis.title.x  = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size + 1.9),   # original +8
      axis.title.y  = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size + 1.9),   # original +8
      plot.title    = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size + 2.4, face = "bold"),   # original +10
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size + 1.0)   # original +4
    )

  print(g)
  if (!is.null(filename)) {
    dir.create(dirname(filename), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    ggplot2::ggsave(filename, g, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi)
  }
  invisible(g)
}
```

# 6. Path / Gap plots

```{r}

# Path plot - vline position is the last final_pre_idx + 1
vline_idx <- max(final_pre_idx) + 1

plot_synth_custom(
  type = "path", synth_res = M$so, dataprep_res = M$dp,
  title_main = paste0("SCM Path Plot - ", legend_lbl2),
  title_y = "Weekly traffic",
  treat_time = vline_idx,
  filename = file.path(PLOT,
    sprintf("1.scm_path_%s_%s.jpg", treat_id, LAB)),
  cex_axis = 0.7, cex_lab = 0.7, cex_main = 0.7
)

plot_synth_custom(
  type = "gap", synth_res = M$so, dataprep_res = M$dp,
  title_main = paste0("Gap Plot - ", legend_lbl2),   # <- legend_lbl2 → label_main
  title_y = "Gap (Treated - Synthetic)",
  treat_time = vline_idx,
  filename = file.path(PLOT,
    sprintf("2.scm_gap_%s_%s.jpg", treat_id, LAB)),
  cex_axis = 0.7, cex_lab = 0.7, cex_main = 0.7
)
```

# 7. In-space placebo

```{r placebo}
## ── Treat each donor as treated, same nested procedure (about 20-40 min) ──
cat("placebo", length(donor_ids), "runs — same nested procedure\n")
t0 <- Sys.time()
placebo_results <- purrr::compact(map(donor_ids, function(pid) {
  tryCatch({
    f <- fit_nested(pid, setdiff(donor_ids, pid))
    cat(sprintf("  %3d done (%.0fs)\n", pid,
        as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))))
    list(summary = tibble(placebo_unit = pid, pre = f$pre, post = f$post,
                          ratio = f$ratio, att_abs = f$att, att_pct = f$att_pct),
         path = tibble(placebo_unit = pid, week_index = f$t, placebo_gap = f$gap))
  }, error = function(e) { message("  placebo failed: ", pid); NULL })
}))
plc       <- map_dfr(placebo_results, "summary")
plc_paths <- map_dfr(placebo_results, "path")
cat("succeeded:", nrow(plc), "/", length(donor_ids), "\n")
write_excel_csv(plc %>% rename(placebo_pre_rmspe = pre, placebo_post_rmspe = post,
                               placebo_ratio = ratio, placebo_att_abs = att_abs,
                               placebo_att_pct = att_pct),
                file.path(HERE, sprintf("placebo_summary_%s.csv", LAB)))
write_excel_csv(plc_paths, file.path(HERE, sprintf("placebo_paths_%s.csv", LAB)))
```

```{r pvals}
## ── Permutation p (canonical rule: pre-RMSPE trimming τ, +1 correction) ──
pv <- map_dfr(c(2, 3, 5, Inf), function(tau) {
  sub <- plc %>% filter(is.finite(ratio), pre <= tau * M$pre)
  n <- nrow(sub)
  tibble(tau = tau, n_placebo = n,
         p_ratio     = (1 + sum(sub$ratio >= M$ratio)) / (1 + n),
         p_att_right = (1 + sum(sub$att_abs >= M$att)) / (1 + n))
})
print(as.data.frame(pv), digits = 4)
write_excel_csv(pv, file.path(HERE, "placebo_pvals_tau_D81_nested.csv"))

cat(sprintf("\n★ ATT %+.2f%% | p_ratio(τ5) %.4f  (recorded: +4.76%%, 0.0263)\n",
            M$att_pct, pv$p_ratio[pv$tau == 5]))
```

# 9. Leave-One-Out

```{r loo-plots}
## ── Two LOO variants (revise: full refit / vfix: V fixed) + plots ──────
omit_targets <- w_tbl %>% filter(weight > 0.001) %>% pull(unit_id_num)
cat("LOO target donors (w>0.001):", length(omit_targets), "\n")

for (mode_loo in c("revise", "fixed")) {
  L <- purrr::compact(map(omit_targets, function(d_id) {
    keep <- setdiff(donor_ids, d_id)
    tryCatch({
      f <- fit_nested(treat_id, keep,
                      custom_v = if (mode_loo == "fixed") M$v else NULL)
      list(path = tibble(week = f$t, synthetic = f$Y0, donor = paste0("omit_", d_id)),
           metrics = tibble(unit_id_num = d_id, pre_RMSPE = f$pre, ATT = f$att))
    }, error = function(e) { message("  LOO failed: ", d_id); NULL })
  }))
  sens_loo <- map_dfr(L, "metrics") %>%
    mutate(delta_ATT = ATT - M$att, delta_RMSPE = pre_RMSPE - M$pre) %>%
    left_join(w_tbl, by = "unit_id_num") %>% arrange(desc(abs(delta_ATT)))
  sfx <- if (mode_loo == "fixed") "_vfix" else ""
  cat(sprintf("LOO(%s): ATT range %.1f to %.1f (baseline %.1f)\n",
              mode_loo, min(sens_loo$ATT), max(sens_loo$ATT), M$att))
  write_excel_csv(sens_loo, file.path(HERE, sprintf("loo_sensitivity_%s%s.csv", LAB, sfx)))

  loo_paths <- map_dfr(L, "path")
  gl <- ggplot() +
    geom_line(data = loo_paths, aes(week, synthetic, group = donor),
              colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_line(data = tibble(w = M$t, y = M$Y0), aes(w, y), linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_line(data = tibble(w = M$t, y = M$Y1), aes(w, y), linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = vline_idx, linetype = 3) +
    labs(x = "Week", y = "Weekly users",
         title = paste0("Leave-One-Out - ", legend_lbl2,
                        if (mode_loo == "fixed") " (V fixed)" else " (V re-selected)")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 3.8)   # original 16
  ggsave(file.path(PLOT, sprintf("5.loo_%s%s.jpg", LAB, sfx)),
         gl, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
}
cat("LOO saved\n")
```

# 10. In-time placebo

```{r intime-plots}
## ── Three fake treatment dates inside the pre-period + path plots ─────
fakes <- as.integer(round(quantile(final_pre_idx, c(0.55, 0.70, 0.85))))
cat("in-time fake dates:", paste(fakes, collapse = ", "), "\n")

it <- map_dfr(fakes, function(fs) {
  fake_pre  <- final_pre_idx[final_pre_idx < fs]
  fake_post <- setdiff(final_pre_idx, fake_pre)
  f <- fit_nested(treat_id, donor_ids, pre_idx = fake_pre, eval_post_idx = fake_post)

  plot_synth_custom("path", synth_res = f$so, dataprep_res = f$dp, scale_factor = 0.9, cex_main = 2, legend_redraw = TRUE,
    title_main = paste0("In-time Placebo - ", legend_lbl2),
    title_y = "Weekly users",
    treat_time = fs,
    filename = file.path(PLOT, sprintf("6.in_time_path_%s_f%d.jpg", LAB, fs)))

  tibble(fake_start = fs, n_fake_pre = length(fake_pre), n_fake_post = length(fake_post),
         pre_rmspe = f$pre, fake_att_pct = f$att_pct, ratio = f$ratio)
})
print(as.data.frame(it), digits = 4)
write_excel_csv(it, file.path(HERE, "in_time_summary_D81_nested.csv"))
cat("Passes if the fake ATT is near 0 (small relative to the actual +4.8%).\n")
```
